## Activity

During January 2022, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 50 captures. Activity was completed through the scheduled clinic sessions, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded volume provides the basis for the review of image quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 50 captures, 5 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 10.0. These images could not be used for grading and should remain a focus for routine quality monitoring. The result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity when reviewing service delivery and opportunities to improve image acquisition.

## Grading

Grading identified 5 referable results during January 2022. The median lag from capture to grading was 17 days. This measure indicates the typical interval between the image being taken and the grading decision being recorded. Continued review of grading timeliness, together with the ungradable findings, will support operational monitoring at Hill Counties Health Centre.
